newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end down, off low as Dow, T-bonds bounce.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end down, off low as Dow, T-bonds bounce.

text.p: A rebound in U.S. stocks and bonds helped UK stocks recover from the day's lows by the close on Tuesday, in a day overshadowed by U.S. interest rate fears and worries over the impact of an outbreak of hostilities in Iraq. The FTSE 100 index ended 28.5 points lower at 3,855.9, after rallying from a midsession 48-point tumble. Losers outweighed gainers by three-to-one, with British Airways, airport operator BAA and hotel operators such as Bass buffeted by Iraq tensions.
Dealers said the market reamained on alert for Friday's key U.S. jobs data, after reports that the Federal Reserve was set to hike rates half a point if needed to subdue inflation pressures.
